verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has extensive documented REST API endpoints (incorporation, notarization, translation, tax-registration, trade-registration), webhooks with signature verification, and an llms.txt for AI-native discovery, confirmed reachable via probe. Missing for 10: no verified public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths) and no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the API working end-to-end.
